parameters.name: search_knowledge
parameters.description:
Search the AISHA knowledge base for public information. Returns expert rules, guides, and FAQ content with relevance ranking.

Input: JSON object with: query (string), category (optional string), limit (optional number, default 10).

parameters.name: search_ragnarok
parameters.description:
Search the AISHA document archive using hybrid search (full-text + semantic vectors). Returns passages from verified documents.

Input: JSON object with: query (string), limit (optional number, default 5).

parameters.name: get_knowledge_item
parameters.description:
Get a specific knowledge item by its slug or ID. Returns the full content including markdown body.

Input: JSON object with: slug (string) or id (string UUID).
